Chapter 922: Chapter 20 Entering the Origin of the Immortal Realm (Please Subscribe)

“Yes.”

The disciples present immediately bowed in response.

To their revered master, Ancestor of the Immortal Path, they showed absolute compliance, even considering asking the Ancestor of Martial Tao to come and apologize because they felt that their master’s dignity had been compromised.

“Remember.”

After the Ancestor of the Immortal Path finished speaking, his figure vanished.

“Master… has Master Emerged from Seclusion?” It took a while before a few disciples lifted their heads and exchanged glances.

Despite the unprecedented carnage of the recent war between immortals and demons, resulting in three Immortal Cities being overrun by demonic forces.

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path had not emerged from seclusion, nor had he intervened to deal with the demons.

But now, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path had actively emerged?

What was the reason?

Were they just about to suppress the Ancestor of Martial Tao?

“Could it be that the rumors outside are true?”

The thought surfaced in the hearts of the disciples, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path manifested in person, warning them not to overstep against the Ancestor of Martial Tao, although he did not explain the reason.

But all the top Jade Immortals present were incredibly perceptive, able to deduce many reasons from the command.

And in all the reasons they surmised, there was one common thread.

That was the Ancestor of the Immortal Path harbored immense wariness towards the Ancestor of Martial Tao.

Otherwise, with the capabilities of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, how could he possibly appear just to issue a warning? Not to mention the fact that the Ancestor of Martial Tao did indeed overstep in some respects.

And the wariness of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path further underscored that the Ancestor of Martial Tao existed on the same level as the Ancestor of the Immortal Path.

“Ancestor of Martial Tao…”

The leading direct disciple took a deep breath, only now realizing what he had just done, demanding an existence on the same level as his master to come and apologize?

Lucky that he was stopped by his master, otherwise, if he actually proceeded, even if protected by his master, he probably would never be able to leave the Primordial Lands again.

…

Cangwu Immortal City.

Lin Yuan spent half a day expounding on the essence of Martial Tao.

Through explanation, he also reinterpreted his understanding of Martial Tao, especially as he had already opened up ninety percent of the Ninth Rank Martial Tao Chapter.

“Thank you, Martial Ancestor, for your guidance.”

The multitude of Jade Immortals below bowed respectfully.

If before they came to Cangwu Immortal City, their awe of the Martial Ancestor originated from his invincible power.

Now, the reverence all Jade Immortals felt was for Martial Ancestor himself.

Even though their cultivation did not follow Martial Tao, as all paths of great Dao lead to the same destination. Lin Yuan’s understanding of cosmic rules meant that despite a different path, he could still substantially help the Jade Immortals present.

“You may all leave now.”

Lin Yuan waved his hand.

All at once, the Jade Immortals felt a shift in space-time and in an instant, they found themselves outside Cangwu Immortal City.

“The Martial Tao expounded by Martial Ancestor truly is a grand path that ascends to the heavens.”

“Indeed, I feel it’s in no way inferior to the Immortal Path.”

“What a pity that our paths are already set; otherwise, I really would like to give Martial Tao a try.”

The various Jade Immortals were exhilarated, unsure if it was an illusion, they felt that listening to Lin Yuan’s teachings this time had helped them more than listening to the Ancestral Master.

In facing the teachings of the Ancestral Master, they often encountered incomprehensible aspects, but Martial Ancestor’s teachings? Every sentence was expressed in the simplest and most understandable form.

“Martial Ancestor… impressive.”

“The second Ancestral Master of my Immortal Realm.”

Each of the Jade Immortals was very certain in their hearts. Before today, the Immortal Realm only had one Ancestral Master, and the Demon Abyss had one as well.

But after today, Martial Ancestor will become the second Ancestral Master of the Immortal Realm, the third of the Immortal Realm and Demon Abyss.

…

Cangwu Immortal City.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

Spending half a day lecturing to the many Jade Immortals was merely one of Lin Yuan’s avatars.

“After a few more lectures, I reckon Martial Tao can take root thoroughly in the Immortal Realm,” Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

His audience of learners were all Jade Immortals, and only by gaining the recognition of these powerful beings could Martial Tao flourish rapidly in the Immortal Realm without interference from Ancestral Master-level forces.

“The twelfth layer?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze was profound as he dimly perceived the river of time of the Immortal Realm.

At this moment, he could leap out of the river of time whenever he wished, attempting the ultimate breakthrough.

With the Seventh Realm of Space-Time, combined with Lin Yuan’s various foundational strengths, such as the Heart of Time, he felt that the likelihood of his succeeding in the ultimate breakthrough was very high.

“But there is still the possibility of failure.”

Lin Yuan carefully considered; no matter how high the likelihood, it was still just a possibility.

“Attempting the ultimate breakthrough in the Immortal Realm, as opposed to in the Main Universe, bears no significant difference, and even due to me not being born in the Immortal Realm, some risks might emerge,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

He did entertain the thought of trying in the Immortal Realm, but it lacked significance.

No matter whether in the Immortal Realm or the Main Universe, failure in a breakthrough attempt still spelled death.

Lin Yuan was unsure whether, in the event of a final failure, his spirit and will could survive by escaping into the Myriad Realms Gate, but it’s always good to prepare for the worst in everything.

“Chaos Rule.”

Lin Yuan took a slow breath; as long as he grasped the Chaos Rule, coupled with his current foundation, not to say that stepping into the ultimate realm would be guaranteed, but at least the chances would be much higher than they are now.

Furthermore, realizing the Chaos Rule at the life level of the eleventh layer would bring great benefits to his own transformation, especially when breaking through in the Main Universe, and he would receive an infusion of the Chaos Void Origin, which his mastery of the Chaos Rule would greatly enhance.

…

“Greetings, Teacher.”

“Greetings, Martial Ancestor.”

Li Qing, Shan Yang, Nie Yun, and others stood below with the utmost respect.

After entering the Immortal Realm and adapting for a considerable period, they finally accepted this truth.

“I have already reshaped your flesh for you; the path of cultivation ahead will be somewhat easier,” Lin Yuan said indifferently.

With Lin Yuan’s current realm and strength, reshaping flesh was trivially easy—one thought could mobilize the power of heaven and earth within the Immortal Realm to achieve it.

Of course, reshaping flesh is just that, reshaping flesh. If one wishes to walk further on the Martial Tao evolutionary path, to step into the Ninth, Tenth, or even Eleventh Stage, it still depends on oneself.

A strong physical body can only make for a higher starting point. As for how far one ultimately goes, these are actually not so important.

Most of the twelve-tier ultimate beings in the Main Universe come from ordinary clans. Among those who achieve the twelfth tier with a unique and unparalleled life form, there is only one.

Most of the twelfth-tier powerhouses in the Star Alliance are normal special life forms.

“Venerated Martial Ancestor Rank.”

Li Qing and the others immediately responded.

“You may all leave now.”

Lin Yuan waved his hand, watching Li Qing and the others depart.

“Parents…” Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted, and the situation of Jun Dongjin and others appeared before his eyes.

Compared to beings like Li Qing at the pinnacle of the Eighth Layer of Martial Tao, Jun Dongjin only had the strength of the Refining Void Period when he died.

After entering the Immortal Realm, they would need much longer to adapt than Li Qing and the others.

“This is all I can do,” Lin Yuan thought silently to himself. He went against the current, revived his relatives who had traversed twice, and reshaped their flesh, extending their lives by millions or tens of millions of years.

Next, if they wanted to advance further, there was not much more Lin Yuan could help with.

…

“It’s time to head to the Primordial Lands of the Immortal Realm.”

Lin Yuan’s figure vanished and reappeared beneath the irregular fissure in the Cave Mansion Area.

After stepping into the Seventh Realm of time and space, Lin Yuan planned to venture into the Origin of the Immortal Realm for experience, and he had informed the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss about this.

“Let’s go.”

This incarnation of Lin Yuan immediately entered the irregular fissure.

The nature of the irregular fissure is a passage that leads to the Primordial Lands of the Immortal Realm.

However, this passage is extremely dangerous, filled with numerous spatial-temporal storms, and even a top Jade Immortal would face life and death risks if they recklessly entered.

But Lin Yuan is not a Jade Immortal; even before he stepped into the Seventh Realm of space and time, Lin Yuan already possessed the strength to enter the Primordial Lands through the irregular fissure.

It was only because of his wariness towards the Ancestor of the Immortal Path that he did not do so.

Now, with insights obtained in the Seventh Realm of space and time, there’s naturally no problem.

Boom boom boom~

The irregular fissure’s channel is endless at first glance, filled with a labyrinth of terrifying spatial-temporal storms.

Lin Yuan strolled leisurely, all the raging forces of space-time becoming incredibly calm when they came within a hundred yards of him.

Lin Yuan walked within the irregular fissure, this passage to the Primordial Lands of the Immortal Realm, which was initially extremely narrow but became more spacious the deeper he went.

“Fluctuations of rules…”

Lin Yuan hadn’t yet entered the Primordial Lands but already felt waves of massive rule fluctuations rushing towards him, with various rules manifesting before his eyes and their operational details flooding into his mind.

“How marvelous.”

Lin Yuan observed attentively, feeling as if countless inspirations were exploding within him.

All of these flashes of insight mainly came from pillar-level fusion rules and the like, as for the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule? There was very little in comparison.

Now, Lin Yuan’s insights into the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule have already reached their limit.

This limit refers not to Lin Yuan’s own, but to that of the Immortal Realm.

To go further than this? Is not something that can be comprehended while residing in the Immortal Realm.

“Golden Rules? Five Elements Rules? Cycle of the Five Elements Rule?”

“Infinite Rules, Space Rules, Infinite Space Rules?”

“Pinnacle of Chaos Rule?”

“Material Illusion Rule?”

…

A multitude of pillar-level rules continuously poured into Lin Yuan’s heart, many of which Lin Yuan had never previously encountered. Now they surged forth like rivers entering the sea.

[Your comprehension is heaven-defying, experiencing the manifestation of myriad essential rule fluctuations, greatly enhancing your insight into the Cycle of the Five Elements Rule…]

…

[Your comprehension is heaven-defying, experiencing the manifestation of myriad essential rule fluctuations, greatly enhancing your insight into the Infinite Space Rules…]

…

[Your comprehension is heaven-defying, experiencing the manifestation of myriad essential rule fluctuations, greatly enhancing your insight into the Pinnacle of Chaos Rule…]

…

Endless brilliance erupted rapidly, with numerous rules interweaving and clashing faintly across Lin Yuan’s form, rapidly calming down the surrounding volatile space-time.

…

Primordial Lands of the Immortal Realm.

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path was waiting for Lin Yuan to arrive.

He and the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss were originally one and the same; the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss agreeing to Lin Yuan was equivalent to the Ancestor of the Immortal Path agreeing as well.

In fact, even if the Ancestor of the Immortal Path did not agree, it wouldn’t make any difference; the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss exhausted all efforts and could not touch even a hair on Lin Yuan, and the Ancestor of the Immortal Path was likely the same.

“Has Martial Ancestor entered?”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path, who personally opened up each irregular fissure leading to the Primordial Lands, was well-versed with every one of them and immediately sensed one of Lin Yuan’s incarnations entering the fissure.

“Hmm?”

“Why has he stopped?”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path patiently waited for a while but noticed that Lin Yuan had yet to enter the Primordial Lands.

“What’s this?”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path frowned, peering at Lin Yuan who had stopped in place. His form was manifesting numerous clashing rules, as if nurturing some sort of Origin Rule.

“An epiphany?”

“Without even entering the Primordial Lands, he has had an epiphany?”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path fell into silence.
